parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle or lever of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts around a pivot point to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of brass, which connects the spout and switch and houses the internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the faucet structure, connects to the water supply, and channels water to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet tube of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet body to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel or rotate horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
